name: Yes Bank Ltd.
business_summary: Private bank rebuilt since the 2020 RBI-led reconstruction, with SMBC (Japan) the largest strategic shareholder. Deposits Rs 3.54 lakh cr and total assets Rs 5.15 lakh cr (Sep 2026); revenue Rs 8,650 cr in Q2 FY27, net profit Rs 1,084 cr (+63-65% YoY), NII +23%. On 2026-10-15 the Supreme Court voided the 2020 write-off of Rs 8,415 cr AT1 bonds; the post-tax earnings/capital hit is estimated at Rs 5,200-5,400 cr and was not booked in Q2. Stock down 23% in a month, trading at 0.94x book.

exposures.mechanism: Roughly half of advances are repo/EBLR-linked (model knowledge) and reprice in 1-3m while CASA/term deposits reprice slower, so a +25bp hike compresses NIM ~5-8bp near term: 6bp x Rs 2.9 lakh cr loans (assumed) = Rs 175 cr = ~3% of annualised PBT (~Rs 5,800 cr); EV/MCap ~1 for bank; persistence 0.5 -> -1.5, doubled for discount-rate effect on a sub-1x book stock -> -3.0.

evidence.note: RBI MPC hiked repo 25bp to 5.50%, stance calibrated tightening (Reuters/The Hindu headlines)

exposures.mechanism: Investments Rs 99,968 cr (Sep-26); assume ~40% AFS with duration ~2.5y: +25bp = Rs 250 cr MTM = ~4% of annualised PBT, partly absorbed by AFS reserve; plus cost-of-equity effect on valuation -> -3.0.
